propositions: Plan-review gate has no criterion checking whether a proposed change is actually needed (necessity gap matching FixedBench over-action finding).
Bug tickets currently short-circuit plan-review gate to bare exempt-PASS with zero LLM calls and zero substantive review (verified on bug 5886).
New advisory `necessity` criterion flags plans that do not demonstrate change is needed without blocking, accepting justified no-op/docs/well-motivated outcomes.
Bugs now receive lightweight advisory review tier (DET floor + necessity probe only) instead of full gate exemption.
Both criteria ship advisory and auto-flow into standing recorder for effectiveness monitoring before promotion to blocking.
Advisory->blocking promotion remains dogfood-gated on standing recorder metrics (detection_proxy, blocking_fp_proxy, sample sufficiency).
